name: schema_version
description: Version of the canonical onboarding contract.

name: submitted_at
description: UTC timestamp supplied by the onboarding application.

name: organisation_id
description: Tenant boundary used for audit and access control.

name: emirate
description: One of the seven United Arab Emirates emirates.

name: diagnosis_codes
description: Controlled diagnosis codes; empty when no formal diagnosis is declared.

name: guardian_phone_e164
description: Guardian telephone number in International Telecommunication Union E.164 format.

name: consent_to_process
description: Explicit permission to process the submitted personal data.

name: consent_timestamp
description: UTC timestamp when the guardian granted consent.

name: requested_hours_per_week
description: Whole support hours requested each week; zero when support is not requested.

name: dcyn_all_rules_passed
description: True only when every Deconstruction of Compliance into Yes or No rule returns Yes.

name: dcyn_failed_rule_ids
description: Identifiers of failed binary rules; empty for an accepted event.

name: ingested_at
description: UTC timestamp assigned by the ingestion boundary.

name: source_object_uri
description: Immutable Cloud Storage source object and generation URI.
